overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's brief discussion of postponing an unnoticed license item was procedural, and the item was later properly noticed and voted on. The AG also reminded the Board to review complaints itself before having anyone respond.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed a Sonic Drive-In common victualler license application that was not listed on the October 18, 2016 meeting notice.
allegations.key_passage: discussions of scheduling or procedural information are exempt from the Open Meeting Law's definition of "deliberation."

allegations.summary: Not raised by the complainant: the Board's administrative assistant responded to the complaint before the Board itself reviewed it. The AG issued a reminder only.
allegations.key_passage: The body must review the complaint before authorizing legal counsel, or any other individual, to respond on its behalf.
